migrations.rollbackStrategy: Fresh databases can be discarded and recreated. Existing databases must be fingerprinted and marked as baselined; never apply 0000 over them. Production recovery requires a separately approved provider restore or reviewed forward repair.
migrations.environmentStatus: Repository baseline only; no development, staging or production database was inspected or changed.
cautions: Generated from Drizzle schema with partial and expression index predicates manually restored and validator-locked.
Must be compared with each existing environment before that environment is enrolled in ordered migrations.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: The application query is compatible before and after index creation. If index rollout causes an operational problem, roll back the application and remove only these two additive indexes through a separately reviewed forward repair; no user data is transformed.
migrations.environmentStatus: Generated and validated in the repository only; not applied to any database.
cautions: Preflight aborts safely if legacy usernames or emails collide after lowercasing and does not print the identifiers.
Index creation can lock or consume resources on a large users table; apply only in an approved window after measuring the target environment.
